objects.name: Accounts
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Accounts" (
    "AccountId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Accounts" PRIMARY KEY,
    "DisplayName" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Email" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Password" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ImapServer" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ImapPort" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "ImapUseSsl" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "SmtpServer" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SmtpPort" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "SmtpUseSsl" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "IsActive" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "CreatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "InviteToken" TEXT NULL,
    "PublicKey" TEXT NULL,
    "KeyFingerprint" TEXT NULL
, "AvatarColor" TEXT NULL, "PrivateKey" TEXT NULL)

objects.name: Attachments
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Attachments" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Attachments" PRIMARY KEY,
    "Caption" TEXT NULL,
    "ContentType" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "FileName" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "FilePath" TEXT NULL,
    "Height" INTEGER NULL,
    "IsImage" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "MessageId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Size" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Width" INTEGER NULL
)

objects.name: Chats
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Chats" (
    "ChatId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Chats" PRIMARY KEY,
    "Type" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "AccountId" TEXT NULL,
    "LastMessageId" TEXT NULL,
    "UnreadCount" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Muted" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Archived" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Priority" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "CreatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "LastActivityAt" TEXT NULL
, "Deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "PartnerEmail" TEXT NULL)

objects.name: Contacts
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Contacts" (
    "Email" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Contacts" PRIMARY KEY,
    "DisplayName" TEXT NULL,
    "PublicKey" TEXT NULL,
    "KeyFingerprint" TEXT NULL,
    "Verified" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "LastSeen" TEXT NULL,
    "ProtocolVersion" TEXT NULL,
    "SupportsBatching" INTEGER NOT NULL
)

objects.name: GroupKeyPairs
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "GroupKeyPairs" (
    "GroupId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_GroupKeyPairs" PRIMARY KEY,
    "PublicKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "PrivateKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CreatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: GroupMembers
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "GroupMembers" (
    "GroupId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "MemberEmail" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Role" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "AddedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "AddedBy" TEXT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_GroupMembers" PRIMARY KEY ("GroupId", "MemberEmail"),
    CONSTRAINT "FK_GroupMembers_Groups_GroupId" FOREIGN KEY ("GroupId") REFERENCES "Groups" ("GroupId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("GroupId") REFERENCES "Groups" ("GroupId") ON DELETE CASCADE

objects.name: GroupOperations
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "GroupOperations" (
    "Id" INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_GroupOperations" PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    "GroupId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Version" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Operation" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Actor" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Target" TEXT NULL,
    "Timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Applied" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_GroupOperations_Groups_GroupId" FOREIGN KEY ("GroupId") REFERENCES "Groups" ("GroupId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("GroupId") REFERENCES "Groups" ("GroupId") ON DELETE CASCADE

objects.name: Groups
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Groups" (
    "GroupId" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Groups" PRIMARY KEY,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Version" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "CreatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "AvatarHash" TEXT NULL
)

objects.name: MessageReactions
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "MessageReactions" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_MessageReactions" PRIMARY KEY,
    "MessageId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Emoji" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Sender" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL
)

objects.name: Messages
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "Messages" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_Messages" PRIMARY KEY,
    "MessageId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ChatId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Sender" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Content" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "DisplayTimestamp" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ReceivedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Encrypted" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "AttachmentPath" TEXT NULL,
    "InReplyTo" TEXT NULL,
    "IsEdited" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "EditVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "ClockSkewDetected" INTEGER NOT NULL, Status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "ImapUid" INTEGER NULL, "ImapFolder" TEXT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "FK_Messages_Chats_ChatId" FOREIGN KEY ("ChatId") REFERENCES "Chats" ("ChatId") ON DELETE CASCADE
)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("ChatId") REFERENCES "Chats" ("ChatId") ON DELETE CASCADE
